name: Juri
source:
The student council vice president, she is cheerful and kind to people close to her and likes ikemen.

Her hobbies include watching ikemen and fantasizing. She nicknamed Leito and Yuzuki "Knight and Prince," which quickly reached other female students...

[Translated from [url=http://b-cluster.eek.jp/requartz/character/juri.html]official website[/url]]
